items.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
items.fields: S1 & S2 coursework di School of Business and Law, Arts and Humanities, Engineering, Education, Science, Medical and Health Sciences (kampus Joondalup & City, Perth)
items.coverage: Bursary tunai AUD 5.000 untuk biaya hidup, dibayar 2 x AUD 2.500 (akhir semester 1 & 2 tahun pertama)
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru (termasuk WNI) yang mulai S1/S2 coursework tahun 2027 lewat direct entry (bukan paket pathway); tanpa credit transfer/advanced standing/RPL; bukan program kuota (mis. Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46); full-time & on-campus, bukan penerima beasiswa pemerintah/sponsor.
items.notes: Tidak perlu daftar terpisah: dinilai otomatis saat apply program ECU. Menurut ECU, bisa digabung ASEAN International Scholarship 20% (contoh: Bachelor of Communication tahun 1 AUD 39.600 -> AUD 26.680, hemat AUD 12.920). Dibayar ke rekening bank Australia. Daftar lewat konsultan Talented.

en.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
en.fields: Bachelor's & Master's by coursework in the Schools of Business and Law, Arts and Humanities, Engineering, Education, Science, Medical and Health Sciences (Joondalup & City campuses, Perth)
en.coverage: AUD 5,000 cash bursary for living costs, paid as 2 x AUD 2,500 (end of semester 1 & 2 of the first year)
en.eligibility: New international students (Indonesians included) starting a Bachelor's/Master's by coursework in 2027 via direct entry (not a pathway package); no credit transfer/advanced standing/RPL; not a quota course (e.g. Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46); full-time and on campus, not government/sponsor funded.
en.english_test: As per ECU course entry requirements
en.notes: No separate application: assessed automatically when you apply to ECU. According to ECU it can be combined with the 20% ASEAN International Scholarship (example: Bachelor of Communication year 1 AUD 39,600 -> AUD 26,680, saving AUD 12,920). Paid into an Australian bank account. Apply through your Talented consultant.

th.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
th.country: ออสเตรเลีย
th.fields: ปริญญาตรีและปริญญาโทแบบ coursework ใน School of Business and Law, Arts and Humanities, Engineering, Education, Science, Medical and Health Sciences (วิทยาเขต Joondalup และ City, เพิร์ธ)
th.coverage: เงินช่วยเหลือค่าครองชีพ AUD 5,000 จ่าย 2 งวด งวดละ AUD 2,500 (ปลายภาคเรียนที่ 1 และ 2 ของปีแรก)
th.eligibility: นักศึกษาต่างชาติใหม่ (รวมชาวอินโดนีเซีย) ที่เริ่มปริญญาตรี/โท coursework ในปี 2027 แบบ direct entry (ไม่ใช่แพ็กเกจ pathway) ไม่มีการเทียบโอนหน่วยกิต/RPL ไม่ใช่หลักสูตรโควตา (เช่น Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46) เรียนเต็มเวลาในวิทยาเขต และไม่ได้รับทุนรัฐบาล/ผู้สนับสนุน
th.english_test: ตามเกณฑ์รับเข้าหลักสูตรของ ECU
th.intake: ทุกรอบปี 2027
th.notes: ไม่ต้องสมัครแยก พิจารณาอัตโนมัติเมื่อสมัครเรียนที่ ECU ตามข้อมูลจาก ECU ใช้ร่วมกับ ASEAN International Scholarship 20% ได้ (ตัวอย่าง: Bachelor of Communication ปีแรก AUD 39,600 -> AUD 26,680 ประหยัด AUD 12,920) จ่ายเข้าบัญชีธนาคารในออสเตรเลีย สมัครผ่านที่ปรึกษา Talented

vi.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
vi.fields: Cử nhân & thạc sĩ coursework thuộc School of Business and Law, Arts and Humanities, Engineering, Education, Science, Medical and Health Sciences (cơ sở Joondalup & City, Perth)
vi.coverage: Trợ cấp tiền mặt AUD 5.000 cho sinh hoạt, trả 2 lần x AUD 2.500 (cuối học kỳ 1 & 2 năm đầu)
vi.eligibility: Sinh viên quốc tế mới (gồm người Indonesia) bắt đầu cử nhân/thạc sĩ coursework năm 2027 theo direct entry (không theo gói pathway); không chuyển tín chỉ/advanced standing/RPL; không phải ngành có hạn ngạch (vd. Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46); học toàn thời gian tại trường, không nhận tài trợ chính phủ/nhà tài trợ.
vi.english_test: Theo yêu cầu đầu vào của ECU
vi.notes: Không cần nộp đơn riêng: tự động xét khi nộp hồ sơ ECU. Theo ECU có thể kết hợp với ASEAN International Scholarship 20% (ví dụ: Bachelor of Communication năm 1 AUD 39.600 -> AUD 26.680, tiết kiệm AUD 12.920). Trả vào tài khoản ngân hàng Úc. Đăng ký qua tư vấn viên Talented.

zh.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
zh.fields: 商法学院、文学与人文、工程、教育、理学、医学与健康科学学院的本科及授课型硕士（珀斯 Joondalup 与 City 校区）
zh.coverage: AUD 5,000 生活补助金，分两期各 AUD 2,500（第一年第 1、2 学期末发放）
zh.eligibility: 2027 年以直录（非 pathway 套餐）入读本科/授课型硕士的国际新生（含印尼学生）；无学分转换/免修/RPL；非配额课程（如 Nursing C33、Master of Nursing J46）；全日制在校，且未获政府/赞助资助。
zh.english_test: 按 ECU 课程入学要求
zh.notes: 无需单独申请：申请 ECU 课程时自动评估。据 ECU 说明可与 20% ASEAN International Scholarship 叠加（例：Bachelor of Communication 第一年 AUD 39,600 -> AUD 26,680，节省 AUD 12,920）。补助金汇入澳洲银行账户。请通过 Talented 顾问申请。

ja.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
ja.fields: ビジネス・法学、人文、工学、教育、理学、医療・健康科学スクールの学士・コースワーク修士（パース Joondalup・City キャンパス）
ja.coverage: 生活費用の給付金 AUD 5,000（初年度の第1・第2学期末に AUD 2,500 ずつ2回）
ja.eligibility: 2027年に直接入学（パスウェイのパッケージ以外）で学士／コースワーク修士を始める新規留学生（インドネシア人含む）。単位認定・RPL なし、定員管理コース（Nursing C33、Master of Nursing J46 等）以外、フルタイム・キャンパス就学、政府・スポンサー資金なし。
ja.english_test: ECU の入学要件に準拠
ja.notes: 別途申請不要：ECU 出願時に自動審査。ECU によると ASEAN International Scholarship 20% と併用可（例：Bachelor of Communication 初年度 AUD 39,600 -> AUD 26,680、AUD 12,920 節約）。オーストラリアの銀行口座に支給。Talented のコンサルタント経由で出願。

ko.name: 2027 ECU Kickstart Bursary
ko.fields: 경영·법학, 인문, 공학, 교육, 자연과학, 의학·보건과학 스쿨의 학사 및 코스워크 석사(퍼스 Joondalup·City 캠퍼스)
ko.coverage: 생활비 지원금 AUD 5,000, 1학년 1·2학기 말에 AUD 2,500씩 2회 지급
ko.eligibility: 2027년 direct entry(패스웨이 패키지 제외)로 학사/코스워크 석사를 시작하는 신규 유학생(인도네시아인 포함); 학점 인정/advanced standing/RPL 없음; 정원 관리 과정 제외(예: Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46); 전일제 캠퍼스 수강, 정부/스폰서 지원 없음.
ko.notes: 별도 신청 불필요: ECU 지원 시 자동 심사. ECU에 따르면 ASEAN International Scholarship 20%와 함께 받을 수 있음(예: Bachelor of Communication 1학년 AUD 39,600 -> AUD 26,680, AUD 12,920 절약). 호주 은행 계좌로 지급. Talented 컨설턴트를 통해 지원하세요.

km.fields: បរិញ្ញាបត្រ និងអនុបណ្ឌិត coursework ក្នុង School of Business and Law, Arts and Humanities, Engineering, Education, Science, Medical and Health Sciences (បរិវេណ Joondalup និង City, Perth)
km.coverage: ប្រាក់ឧបត្ថម្ភរស់នៅ AUD 5,000 បង់ 2 ដង ម្តង AUD 2,500 (ចុងឆមាសទី 1 និង 2 ឆ្នាំដំបូង)
km.eligibility: និស្សិតអន្តរជាតិថ្មី (រួមទាំងឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី) ចាប់ផ្តើមបរិញ្ញាបត្រ/អនុបណ្ឌិត coursework ឆ្នាំ 2027 តាម direct entry (មិនមែនកញ្ចប់ pathway); គ្មានការផ្ទេរក្រេឌីត/RPL; មិនមែនវគ្គកូតា (ឧ. Nursing C33, Master of Nursing J46); សិក្សាពេញម៉ោងនៅបរិវេណ មិនទទួលមូលនិធិរដ្ឋាភិបាល/អ្នកឧបត្ថម្ភ។

items.name: Beasiswa LPDP STEM Industri Strategis (Magister & Doktor)
items.fields: STEM industri strategis (kesehatan, pangan, energi, maritim, pertahanan, digitalisasi/AI & semikonduktor, hilirisasi, material & manufaktur maju) + bidang pendukung (bisnis & ekonomi, kebijakan publik & hukum, kewirausahaan/industri kreatif)
items.coverage: Skema penuh: biaya pendaftaran, tuition, buku, riset tesis/disertasi, transport, visa, asuransi kesehatan, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan; tersedia juga skema parsial (kriteria Umum dan CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI)
items.eligibility: WNI; Magister IPK min. 3,00 dan usia maks. 35 th, Doktor IPK 3,25 dan usia maks. 40 th (kriteria Umum); ada kriteria Afirmasi (Papua, Daerah Afirmasi, Prasejahtera, Disabilitas) dengan syarat lebih ringan; LN Magister IELTS 6.5, Doktor IELTS 7.0 (Afirmasi IELTS 6.0).
items.english_test: Magister: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58 / Duolingo 120; Doktor: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Afirmasi: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
items.notes: Tahap 2 2026 ditutup (pendaftaran 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026; seleksi substansi 14 Okt-20 Nov 2026, pengumuman 30 Nov 2026; kuliah paling cepat Jan 2027). Jadwal tahap 1 2027 belum diumumkan di sumber resmi yang dapat diakses. Pemegang LoA unconditional dikecualikan dari syarat sertifikat bahasa Inggris. Situs utama lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id tidak dapat diakses saat pengecekan; data diverifikasi dari buku panduan resmi LPDP.

en.name: LPDP STEM Strategic Industries Scholarship (Master's & Doctorate)
en.fields: Strategic-industry STEM (health, food, energy, maritime, defence, digitalisation/AI & semiconductors, downstreaming, advanced materials & manufacturing) + supporting fields (business & economics, public policy & law, entrepreneurship/creative industries)
en.coverage: Full scheme: application fees, tuition, books, thesis/dissertation research, transport, visa, health insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance; partial schemes also available (General and civil servant/military/police criteria)
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens; Master's GPA min. 3.00 and max. age 35, Doctorate GPA 3.25 and max. age 40 (General criteria); Affirmative criteria (Papua, affirmative regions, low-income, disability) with lighter requirements; overseas Master's IELTS 6.5, Doctorate IELTS 7.0 (Affirmative IELTS 6.0).
en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58 / Duolingo 120; Doctorate: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Affirmative: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
en.notes: 2026 Round 2 is closed (registration 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026; substantive selection 14 Oct-20 Nov 2026, announcement 30 Nov 2026; studies start January 2027 at the earliest). The 2027 Round 1 schedule has not been announced in accessible official sources. Holders of an unconditional LoA are exempt from the English certificate requirement. The main site lpdp.kemenkeu.go.id could not be accessed at the time of checking; data verified from the official LPDP guidebook.

items.english_test: Magister: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58; Doktor: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Afirmasi: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)
items.notes: Periode 2026 tahap 2 (pendaftaran 30 Jun-31 Jul 2026) sudah ditutup; seleksi substansi 14 Okt-20 Nov 2026, pengumuman 30 Nov 2026. en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 58; Doctorate: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65 (Affirmative: IELTS 6.0 / iBT 61 / PTE 50)

items.name: Beasiswa LPDP Akselerasi pada Universitas Unggulan
items.fields: Semua bidang di universitas unggulan kategori A; bidang STEM tertentu di kategori B
items.coverage: Pendaftaran, tuition, buku, riset, seminar & publikasi internasional, transport, visa, asuransi, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup, tunjangan keluarga (doktor)
items.eligibility: WNI yang sudah memegang LoA (wajib untuk Magister) dari daftar Universitas Unggulan LPDP; Doktor tanpa LoA wajib IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
items.english_test: Magister: tidak disyaratkan; Doktor dengan LoA: tanpa minimum; Doktor tanpa LoA: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65
items.notes: Putaran 2026 (pendaftaran 6-27 Mar 2026, kuliah paling cepat Jul 2026) sudah ditutup. Jadwal putaran berikutnya belum diumumkan. Magister: tidak ada syarat sertifikat bahasa Inggris (wajib LoA). Daftar universitas unggulan mencakup kampus top di AS, Inggris, Jerman, Jepang, Singapura, dll.

en.name: LPDP Acceleration Scholarship at Leading Universities
en.fields: All fields at category A leading universities; selected STEM fields at category B

en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens holding an LoA (required for Master's) from LPDP's list of leading universities; Doctorate applicants without an LoA need IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
en.english_test: Master's: not required; Doctorate with LoA: no minimum; Doctorate without LoA: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65
en.notes: The 2026 round (registration 6-27 Mar 2026, studies from July 2026 at the earliest) is closed. The next round has not been announced. Master's: no English certificate required (LoA mandatory). The list of top universities includes leading campuses in the US, UK, Germany, Japan, Singapore and others.

items.name: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships (LPDP-AAS)
items.fields: Digitalisasi (AI & semikonduktor), energi, hilirisasi & industrialisasi, kesehatan, ketahanan pangan, maritim, material & manufaktur maju
items.coverage: Tuition, pendaftaran, buku, riset tesis, seminar/publikasi, transport, visa, asuransi, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan, pelatihan pra-keberangkatan
items.eligibility: WNI lulusan D4/S1 (belum memiliki S2), program Master single degree 24 bulan di ~30 universitas Australia; IELTS 6.5 (tiap band min. 6.0) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84.
items.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 tiap band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84
items.notes: Putaran untuk mulai kuliah 2027 dibuka 2 Apr-4 Mei 2026 (sudah ditutup). Pendaftaran via portal LPDP (beasiswalpdp-terintegrasi.kemenkeu.go.id). Putaran intake 2028 belum diumumkan di laman Australia Awards Indonesia.

en.name: LPDP-Australia Awards Scholarships (LPDP-AAS)
en.provider: LPDP (Indonesian Ministry of Finance) & Australian Government (DFAT)
en.fields: Digitalisation (AI & semiconductors), energy, downstreaming & industrialisation, health, food security, maritime, advanced materials & manufacturing
en.coverage: Tuition, application, books, thesis research, seminars/publications, transport, visa, insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance, pre-departure training
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a D4/Bachelor's degree (no Master's yet), for a 24-month single-degree Master's at ~30 Australian universities; IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84.
en.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / PTE 58 / TOEFL iBT 84
en.notes: The round for studies starting in 2027 was open 2 Apr-4 May 2026 (now closed). Applications via the LPDP portal (beasiswalpdp-terintegrasi.kemenkeu.go.id). The 2028 intake round has not been announced on the Australia Awards Indonesia website.

items.name: Beasiswa Doktor Talenta Riset dan Inovasi Nasional BRIN - Jalur Doctor by Research
items.fields: Riset sektor prioritas: kesehatan, pangan, digitalisasi, hilirisasi, pertahanan, material & manufaktur, energi, maritim
items.coverage: Pendaftaran, tuition, seminar & publikasi internasional, transport (LN), visa, asuransi kesehatan, dana darurat
items.eligibility: WNI lulusan S2 (atau D4/S1 langsung doktor dengan LoA unconditional) untuk program doctor by research; LN IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
items.notes: Putaran 2026 (pendaftaran 6-27 Mar 2026, pengumuman akhir 22 Jun 2026) sudah ditutup. Terbuka untuk PNS, tidak untuk CPNS/TNI/POLRI; usia maks. 40 th (Umum) / 42 th (PNS). Daftar 2026: 94 program dalam negeri dan 19 program luar negeri (Inggris, Australia, Rusia, Prancis, Belanda). Jadwal berikutnya belum diumumkan.

en.name: BRIN National Research & Innovation Talent Doctoral Scholarship - Doctor by Research
en.fields: Priority-sector research: health, food, digitalisation, downstreaming, defence, materials & manufacturing, energy, maritime
en.coverage: Application, tuition, international seminars & publications, transport (overseas), visa, health insurance, emergency fund
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens with a Master's (or D4/Bachelor's going straight to doctorate with an unconditional LoA) for a doctor-by-research programme; overseas IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65.
en.english_test: IELTS 7.0 / TOEFL iBT 94 / PTE 65
en.notes: The 2026 round (registration 6-27 Mar 2026, final announcement 22 Jun 2026) is closed. Open to civil servants (PNS), not to CPNS/TNI/POLRI; maximum age 40 (General) / 42 (PNS). 2026 list: 94 domestic and 19 overseas programs (UK, Australia, Russia, France, Netherlands). The next schedule has not been announced.

items.name: Beasiswa Garuda Sarjana (S1 Luar Negeri)
items.fields: Pilih 2 dari 10 bidang prioritas: kesehatan, ketahanan pangan, pertahanan, digitalisasi, hilirisasi industri, material & manufaktur maju, maritim, energi, bisnis & ekonomi, hukum & kebijakan publik
items.coverage: Dana pendidikan (SPP/tuition, biaya pendaftaran, tunjangan buku) dan dana pendukung (transport, visa, asuransi kesehatan, kedatangan, tunjangan hidup bulanan, dana darurat/force majeure)
items.eligibility: WNI siswa kelas 12 SMA/SMK/MA TA 2026/2027; rata-rata rapor semester 1-4 min. 85 (atau IB predicted 36 / A-Level AAA / ACT 28); IQ min. 120 dari biro psikologi PT binaan Kemdiktisaintek (akreditasi min. Baik, maks. 2 tahun); SAT min. 1200 atau ikut Tes Bakat Skolastik (min. 1000); surat sehat (termasuk tes buta warna) & bebas narkoba.
items.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 tiap band) / TOEFL iBT 86 / TOEFL ITP 550; atau bahasa negara tujuan (Prancis B2, Spanyol B1, HSK 4 skor 180, JLPT N3, Jerman C1)
items.notes: Pendaftaran 2027 (tujuan luar negeri) DIBUKA 12 Nov 2026-4 Jan 2027 di beasiswalpdp-terintegrasi.kemenkeu.go.id. Tes Bakat Skolastik 18-22 Jan 2027; pengumuman seleksi administrasi 5 Feb 2027; wawancara penempatan menyusul. Pilih 6 kampus (1 AS/Kanada, 1 Australia/Selandia Baru, 2 Eropa, 2 Asia); kampus & program akhir ditentukan saat wawancara penempatan. Tidak perlu LoA saat mendaftar. Penerima dapat menunda keberangkatan maks. 1 tahun; wajib kembali & berkontribusi di Indonesia 2x masa studi. Contoh kampus mitra: University of Sheffield (Inggris) menerima lulusan SMA dari sekolah yang diakui Garuda langsung ke S1 tertentu (Geography, International Relations and Politics, Digital Media and Society, Sociology) dengan rata-rata rapor 88-95%; Teknik lewat Sheffield Engineering Foundation Year (rata-rata min. 90% + nilai Matematika & Biologi/Kimia/Fisika). Siswa dari sekolah non-Garuda dinilai per kasus setelah menerima beasiswa. Konsultasikan pilihan kampus dengan Talented.

en.name: Garuda Undergraduate Scholarship (Overseas Bachelor's)
en.provider: Indonesian Ministry of Higher Education, Science & Technology (Ditjen Saintek), funded by LPDP
en.fields: Choose 2 of 10 priority fields: health, food security, defence, digitalisation, industrial downstreaming, advanced materials & manufacturing, maritime, energy, business & economics, law & public policy
en.coverage: Education funds (tuition, application fee, book allowance) and support funds (transport, visa, health insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance, emergency/force majeure costs)
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens in Year 12 (SMA/SMK/MA) in the 2026/2027 school year; report-card average for semesters 1-4 min. 85 (or IB predicted 36 / A-Level AAA / ACT 28); IQ min. 120 from a psychology bureau of a university supervised by the Ministry (accreditation at least 'Baik', max. 2 years old); SAT min. 1200 or the Scholastic Aptitude Test (min. 1000); health certificate (including colour-blindness test) and drug-free certificate.
en.english_test: IELTS 6.5 (min. 6.0 each band) / TOEFL iBT 86 / TOEFL ITP 550; or the destination country's language (French B2, Spanish B1, HSK 4 with 180 points, JLPT N3, German C1)
en.notes: 2027 registration (overseas destinations) is OPEN 12 Nov 2026-4 Jan 2027 at beasiswalpdp-terintegrasi.kemenkeu.go.id. Scholastic Aptitude Test 18-22 Jan 2027; administrative selection results 5 Feb 2027; placement interview to follow. Choose 6 universities (1 US/Canada, 1 Australia/New Zealand, 2 Europe, 2 Asia); the final university and program are decided at the placement interview. No LoA needed to apply. Recipients may defer departure by up to 1 year; they must return and contribute in Indonesia for twice the study period. Partner university example: the University of Sheffield (UK) accepts SMA graduates from Garuda-recognised schools directly into selected bachelor's degrees (Geography, International Relations and Politics, Digital Media and Society, Sociology) with an 88-95% average; Engineering via the Sheffield Engineering Foundation Year (min. 90% average plus Mathematics and Biology/Chemistry/Physics). Students from non-Garuda schools are assessed case by case once awarded. Discuss university choices with Talented.
en.intake: Studies start July 2027 at the earliest (2027/2028 academic year)

items.fields: Semua bidang
items.coverage: Pembiayaan studi doktor di luar negeri maksimal 4 tahun; biaya kuliah harus dibebaskan atau didanai sebagian oleh universitas tujuan (tercantum di LoA/dokumen resmi)
items.eligibility: WNI dosen tetap pada perguruan tinggi di bawah Kemdiktisaintek; mahasiswa baru S3 di universitas luar negeri yang memberikan pembebasan biaya kuliah atau pendanaan sebagian; pendaftaran melalui kualifikasidikti.kemdiktisaintek.go.id.
items.notes: Khusus dosen tetap. Putaran 2026 ditutup 25 Apr 2026; putaran berikutnya belum diumumkan. Kontak: bln.dikti@kemdiktisaintek.go.id.

en.name: Indonesia Partnership Scholarship (BKI) - Overseas Doctorate for Lecturers
en.provider: Indonesian Ministry of Higher Education, Science & Technology
en.coverage: Funding for doctoral study abroad for up to 4 years; tuition must be waived or partly funded by the destination university (stated in the LoA/official documents)
en.eligibility: Indonesian permanent lecturers at higher education institutions under Kemdiktisaintek; new PhD students at overseas universities that provide a tuition waiver or partial funding; apply via kualifikasidikti.kemdiktisaintek.go.id.
en.notes: For permanent lecturers only. The 2026 round closed on 25 Apr 2026; the next round has not been announced. Contact: bln.dikti@kemdiktisaintek.go.id.

items.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Masters & PhD) - Indonesia
items.fields: Bidang prioritas pembangunan Australia Awards Indonesia
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tiket PP, establishment allowance, tunjangan hidup, OSHC, pelatihan bahasa Inggris (EAP) di Indonesia sebelum berangkat
items.eligibility: WNI yang berdomisili dan mendaftar dari Indonesia, bukan anggota militer aktif, belum menerima AAS jangka panjang dalam 4 tahun terakhir; Master IPK 2,9 (kelompok equity 2,75), PhD IPK 3,0 dan khusus staf universitas/lembaga riset/pembuat kebijakan; Master IELTS 6.0 (equity 4.5), PhD IELTS 6.0-6.5.
items.english_test: Master: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 56 / TOEFL ITP 552 (Equity Target Groups: IELTS 4.5 / PTE 32); PhD non-target: IELTS 6.5 / PTE 61
items.notes: Putaran intake 2028 dikonfirmasi di laman resmi: dibuka 1 Feb 2027, ditutup 28 Apr 2027 pukul 11:00 WIB. Seleksi minimal 4 bulan sejak tenggat. Wajib siap mengikuti pelatihan EAP penuh waktu di Indonesia. Dukungan khusus untuk penyandang disabilitas, perempuan dari latar kurang beruntung, dan provinsi target equity (sesi informasi sedang digelar Okt-Nov 2026).

en.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Masters & PhD) - Indonesia
en.fields: Australia Awards Indonesia development priority areas
en.coverage: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living allowance, OSHC, English (EAP) training in Indonesia before departure
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens living in and applying from Indonesia, not active military, not a recipient of a long-term AAS in the last 4 years; Master's GPA 2.9 (equity groups 2.75), PhD GPA 3.0 and only for university/research-institute staff or policy makers; Master's IELTS 6.0 (equity 4.5), PhD IELTS 6.0-6.5.
en.english_test: Master's: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 56 / TOEFL ITP 552 (Equity Target Groups: IELTS 4.5 / PTE 32); PhD non-target: IELTS 6.5 / PTE 61
en.notes: The 2028 intake round is confirmed on the official website: opens 1 Feb 2027, closes 28 Apr 2027 at 11:00 WIB. Selection takes at least 4 months after the deadline. You must be ready to attend full-time EAP training in Indonesia. Special support for people with disability, women from disadvantaged backgrounds and equity target provinces (information sessions running Oct-Nov 2026).

items.name: Australia Awards Garuda Scholarships
items.fields: Pendidikan / bidang terkait Program Sekolah Garuda (STEM & pendidikan menengah)
items.coverage: Beasiswa jangka panjang Australia Awards (tuition, tunjangan hidup, tiket, OSHC, pelatihan EAP)
items.eligibility: WNI pemegang S1 yang merupakan kepala sekolah/guru di 12 Sekolah Garuda Transformasi (IPK 3,0, IELTS 5.5) atau guru PPG yang bersedia ditempatkan di Sekolah Garuda Baru (NTT, Babel, Kaltara, Sultra).
items.english_test: SGT: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL ITP 500 / TOEFL iBT 52 / PTE 45; SGB: tidak disebutkan
items.notes: Khusus pendidik Program Sekolah Garuda. Putaran intake 2027 dibuka 1 Feb-31 Mei 2026 (tenggat diperpanjang ke 31 Mei 2026; sudah ditutup). Jadwal intake 2028 belum diumumkan.

en.name: Australia Awards Garuda Scholarships
en.fields: Education / fields linked to the Garuda Schools Programme (STEM & secondary education)
en.coverage: Long-term Australia Awards scholarship (tuition, living allowance, airfare, OSHC, EAP training)
en.eligibility: Indonesian Bachelor's holders who are principals/teachers at the 12 Garuda Transformation Schools (GPA 3.0, IELTS 5.5) or PPG teachers willing to be placed at New Garuda Schools (NTT, Bangka Belitung, North Kalimantan, Southeast Sulawesi).
en.english_test: SGT: IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL ITP 500 / TOEFL iBT 52 / PTE 45; SGB: not stated
en.notes: For Garuda School Program educators only. The 2027 intake round was open 1 Feb-31 May 2026 (deadline extended to 31 May 2026; now closed). The 2028 intake schedule has not been announced.

items.name: Australia Awards Short Courses (Indonesia)
items.fields: Tema kebijakan tertentu per kursus (mis. AI & kebijakan publik, energi, keamanan siber, ketahanan pangan, reformasi pendidikan tinggi)
items.coverage: Kursus 2 minggu di Australia plus 2 workshop di Indonesia, dibiayai Pemerintah Australia
items.eligibility: Profesional/pegawai dari instansi Indonesia yang relevan dengan tema kursus; pendaftaran per kursus pada periode yang diumumkan.
items.notes: Semua kursus 2026 sudah lewat masa pendaftaran. Daftar 20 kursus 2027-2028 sudah dirilis (status TBC, dapat dibatalkan), tetapi periode pendaftaran peserta belum diumumkan.

en.name: Australia Awards Short Courses (Indonesia)
en.fields: Specific policy themes per course (e.g. AI & public policy, energy, cyber security, food security, higher-education reform)
en.coverage: 2-week course in Australia plus 2 workshops in Indonesia, funded by the Australian Government
en.eligibility: Professionals/staff of Indonesian institutions relevant to the course theme; apply per course during the announced period.
en.notes: All 2026 courses are past their application period. A list of 20 courses for 2027-2028 has been released (status TBC, may be cancelled), but participant application periods have not been announced.

items.name: ACIAR John Allwright Fellowship
items.fields: Riset pertanian, perikanan, kehutanan, ekonomi terkait proyek ACIAR
items.coverage: Tuition penuh, tiket PP, establishment allowance, tunjangan hidup, OSHC, program akademik pengantar, biaya pra-kursus bahasa Inggris bila perlu, tiket fieldwork
items.eligibility: WNI ilmuwan/ekonom yang terlibat proyek ACIAR dalam 24 bulan terakhir, pegawai tetap/kontrak jangka panjang, minimal S1; hanya Master by Research atau PhD; tes IELTS/TOEFL/PTE terbaru.
items.english_test: IELTS / TOEFL / PTE (skor sesuai syarat universitas)
items.notes: Laman resmi: pendaftaran intake 2027 sudah ditutup; tanggal putaran berikutnya belum diumumkan (hubungi kantor ACIAR regional). Proposal riset wajib memuat kesetaraan gender & inklusi sosial serta perubahan iklim.

en.name: ACIAR John Allwright Fellowship
en.fields: Agricultural, fisheries, forestry and economics research linked to ACIAR projects
en.coverage: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living allowance, OSHC, introductory academic programme, pre-course English if needed, fieldwork airfares
en.eligibility: Indonesian scientists/economists involved in an ACIAR project in the last 24 months, permanent or long-term contract staff, at least a Bachelor's degree; Master by Research or PhD only; recent IELTS/TOEFL/PTE test.
en.english_test: IELTS / TOEFL / PTE (score as required by the university)
en.notes: Official website: applications for the 2027 intake are closed; the next round's dates have not been announced (contact the regional ACIAR office). Research proposals must address gender equality & social inclusion and climate change.

items.name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship
items.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), dikelola universitas
items.fields: Semua bidang (program riset: Master by Research dan PhD)
items.coverage: Offset tuition, stipend biaya hidup, tunjangan biaya tambahan riset (tergantung universitas)
items.eligibility: Terbuka bagi mahasiswa internasional termasuk WNI untuk program riset (HDR) di universitas Australia; seleksi dan syarat (termasuk bahasa Inggris) ditetapkan tiap universitas.
items.notes: Mendaftar langsung ke universitas; tiap kampus punya putaran dan tenggat sendiri (cek situs universitas tujuan). Doktor 3-4 tahun, Master riset hingga 2 tahun. Tarif stipend tahun berikutnya diumumkan paling lambat 1 Okt dan berlaku 1 Jan.

en.name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Scholarship
en.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), administered by universities
en.fields: All fields (research programmes: Master by Research and PhD)
en.coverage: Tuition offset, living-cost stipend, allowance for extra research costs (depends on the university)
en.eligibility: Open to international students, including Indonesians, for research degrees (HDR) at Australian universities; selection and requirements (including English) are set by each university.
en.notes: Apply directly to the university; each campus has its own rounds and deadlines (check the destination university's website). Doctorate 3-4 years, research Master's up to 2 years. Next year's stipend rates are announced by 1 Oct at the latest and apply from 1 Jan.

items.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
items.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), disalurkan via kampus regional
items.fields: Tergantung program yang ditetapkan kampus
items.coverage: Tunjangan studi di kampus regional Australia
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa domestik dan internasional yang kuliah penuh waktu di kampus regional Australia; kelayakan internasional berbeda per kampus (sebagian kampus hanya untuk domestik).
items.notes: Pendaftaran langsung ke kampus penerima dana. Halaman resmi Kementerian Pendidikan Australia hanya memuat informasi putaran 2021 dan tidak memuat jadwal 2027; cek kampus regional tujuan. Kelayakan mahasiswa internasional berbeda per kampus.

en.name: Destination Australia Scholarship
en.provider: Australian Government (Department of Education), distributed through regional campuses
en.fields: Depends on the programmes set by the campus
en.coverage: Study allowance at regional Australian campuses
en.eligibility: Domestic and international students studying full-time at a regional Australian campus; international eligibility differs by campus (some campuses are domestic-only).
en.notes: Apply directly to the funded campus. The Australian Department of Education page only contains 2021 round information and no 2027 schedule; check the destination regional campus. International student eligibility differs by campus.

items.name: ACU Executive Dean's International Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang
items.coverage: Potongan sebagian tuition (fee waiver); berita resmi ACU menyebut juga dukungan perjalanan/relokasi dan biaya visa
items.amount: Potongan sebagian tuition (fee waiver); besaran persentase tidak dicantumkan di halaman resmi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S1/S2 dengan prestasi akademik sangat baik; berita resmi ACU menyebut negara sasaran Vietnam, Filipina, Indonesia, Kamboja, Malaysia, dan Timor Leste.
items.notes: Tidak perlu aplikasi beasiswa terpisah; dinilai dari aplikasi studi. Halaman tidak mencantumkan besaran, tanggal, atau intake 2027 - konfirmasi ke AskACU.

en.name: ACU Executive Dean's International Scholarship
en.coverage: Partial tuition fee waiver; official ACU news also mentions travel/relocation support and visa costs
en.amount: Partial tuition fee waiver; percentage not stated on the official page
en.eligibility: New international Bachelor's/Master's students with excellent academic results; an official ACU news release names Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia, Cambodia, Malaysia and Timor-Leste as target countries.
en.notes: No separate scholarship application; assessed from your course application. The page does not list the amount, dates or 2027 intake - confirm with AskACU.

items.name: ACU International Launch Scholarship
items.fields: Computer Science, Data Science
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru yang mendaftar program Computer Science atau Data Science di ACU.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi formal. Jenjang dan tanggal tidak disebutkan di halaman.

en.name: ACU International Launch Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New international students applying for Computer Science or Data Science at ACU.
en.notes: No formal application. Level and dates are not stated on the page.

items.name: Vice-Chancellor's International High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS)
items.fields: Semua bidang
items.coverage: Potongan 50% tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Nilai keseluruhan minimal 95% pada kualifikasi tertinggi, mulai S1/S2 2027, memenuhi syarat akademik & bahasa Inggris CDU, tidak menerima beasiswa sponsor lain; esai pendukung maks. 600 kata.
items.notes: Perlu aplikasi VCIHAS terpisah setelah mendaftar kuliah. Wajib GPA min. 5.3 tiap semester tanpa nilai gagal. Hasil diumumkan saat Orientation Week. Tenggat Semester 2 2027: 4 Juli 2027.

en.name: Vice-Chancellor's International High Achievers Scholarship (VCIHAS)
en.coverage: 50% tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: Overall result of at least 95% in the highest qualification, starting a Bachelor's/Master's in 2027, meeting CDU academic & English requirements, not receiving another sponsor scholarship; supporting essay max. 600 words.
en.notes: A separate VCIHAS application is required after applying for your course. Minimum GPA 5.3 each semester with no fails. Results announced during Orientation Week. Semester 2 2027 deadline: 4 July 2027.

items.name: CDU Global Merit Scholarship
items.fields: Banyak program TAFE, Bachelor, Master coursework & HDR (ada yang dikecualikan, mis. Bachelor of Nursing, PhD, Master of Research)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Siswa internasional baru yang memulai kursus pertama di CDU tahun 2027, studi penuh waktu dengan visa pelajar, memenuhi syarat masuk; tidak bisa digabung dengan potongan CDU lain.
items.notes: Diberikan otomatis bila memenuhi syarat (tanpa aplikasi terpisah) untuk seluruh durasi kursus. Cek daftar program yang dikecualikan di Terms & Conditions 2027.

en.name: CDU Global Merit Scholarship
en.fields: Many TAFE, Bachelor, coursework Master & HDR courses (some exempt, e.g. Bachelor of Nursing, PhD, Master of Research)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: New international students starting their first CDU course in 2027, studying full-time on a student visa and meeting entry requirements; cannot be combined with other CDU tuition discounts.
en.notes: Awarded automatically if eligible (no separate application) for the whole course. Check the list of exempt courses in the 2027 Terms & Conditions.

items.name: CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship
items.fields: Keperawatan (Bachelor of Nursing)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional Bachelor of Nursing yang mulai 2027, penuh waktu on-campus di Sydney atau Darwin, memenuhi syarat masuk.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar.

en.name: CDU Bachelor of Nursing Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction
en.eligibility: International Bachelor of Nursing students starting in 2027, full-time on campus in Sydney or Darwin, meeting entry requirements.
en.notes: Assessed automatically on application.

items.name: CDU International College Scholarship - China and East Asia
items.fields: Diploma of Business Studies, Diploma of IT, Accelerated International Masters Qualifying Program
items.coverage: Potongan tuition tahun pertama
items.eligibility: Warga negara Indonesia (termasuk daftar negara), mahasiswa baru full-fee & biaya sendiri untuk 2026/2027, lulus wawancara.
items.notes: Indonesia disebut eksplisit. Potongan diberikan saat enrolment, tidak untuk deposit.

en.name: CDU International College Scholarship - China and East Asia
en.fields: Diploma of Business Studies, Diploma of IT, Accelerated International Masters Qualifying Program
en.coverage: First-year tuition reduction
en.eligibility: Indonesian citizens (among listed countries), new full-fee self-funded students for 2026/2027, passing an interview.
en.notes: Indonesia is named explicitly. The reduction is applied at enrolment, not to the deposit.

items.name: International Student Scholarship Program - Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia
items.fields: Bisnis, IT, Akuntansi, Business Analytics
items.coverage: Pengurangan tuition (biaya beasiswa 10% di bawah biaya kursus)
items.eligibility: Warga negara Asia Tenggara/Timur laut yang memenuhi syarat, memenuhi syarat akademik & bahasa Inggris KBS, bukan mahasiswa bersponsor; diajukan sebelum menerima Offer.
items.notes: Dokumen versi 2.0, berlaku mulai Juli 2026 (biaya 2026). Daftar negara tidak dirinci; Indonesia tidak disebut eksplisit - konfirmasi kelayakan WNI ke KBS. Kuota terbatas tiap trimester; tidak bisa digabung dengan beasiswa/promo KBS lain.

en.name: International Student Scholarship Program - Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia
en.coverage: Tuition reduction (scholarship fee 10% below course fee)
en.eligibility: Eligible citizens of Southeast/Northeast Asia meeting KBS academic & English requirements, not sponsored students; must be requested before accepting the Offer.
en.notes: Document version 2.0, effective from July 2026 (2026 fees). The country list is not detailed; Indonesia is not named explicitly - confirm eligibility for Indonesian citizens with KBS. Limited places each trimester; cannot be combined with other KBS scholarships/promotions.

items.name: KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - Indonesia
items.fields: Bisnis, Teknologi Informasi (IT)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition (kredit ke biaya kuliah; hanya tuition, tidak bisa ditukar uang)
items.amount: 2 beasiswa 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); juara 2 & 3 (runner-up) s.d. 30%
items.eligibility: Paspor Indonesia; rata-rata nilai SMA kelas 12 (SMA3) min. 90% atau setara; memenuhi syarat akademik & bahasa Inggris KBS; punya Offer of Admission KBS untuk program sarjana Business atau IT mulai 2027; bukan mahasiswa bersponsor.
items.english_test: Sesuai syarat bahasa Inggris KBS untuk program yang dipilih (boleh dipenuhi sebelum mulai kuliah)
items.notes: Seleksi kompetitif: formulir + video kreatif orisinal 30 detik (Tahap 1), lalu wawancara akademik maks. 15 menit (Tahap 2). Tidak bisa digabung dengan beasiswa/diskon/promo KBS lain kecuali disetujui KBS tertulis. Daftar lewat konsultan Talented (formulir & video dikirim lewat konsultan). Kuota terbatas: pendaftaran ditutup lebih awal bila 80 aplikasi pertama sudah masuk, meski belum 31 Maret 2027 - daftar secepatnya.

en.name: KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - Indonesia
en.coverage: Tuition fee credit (tuition only, not exchangeable for cash)
en.amount: Two 50% scholarships (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1st & 2nd runners-up up to 30%
en.eligibility: Indonesian passport; minimum 90% average in SMA3 (or equivalent); meets KBS academic & English requirements; holds a KBS Offer of Admission for a Business or IT bachelor degree commencing in 2027; not sponsored.
en.notes: Competitive: application form + 30-second original creative video (Stage 1), then an academic interview of up to 15 minutes (Stage 2). Cannot be combined with another KBS scholarship, discount or promotion unless KBS approves in writing. Apply through a Talented consultant. Limited places: applications close early once the first 80 submissions are received, even before 31 March 2027 - apply early.
en.english_test: KBS English requirements for the chosen course (may be met before commencing)

th.name: ทุน KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - อินโดนีเซีย
th.fields: ธุรกิจ, เทคโนโลยีสารสนเทศ
th.coverage: เครดิตค่าเล่าเรียน (เฉพาะค่าเล่าเรียน แลกเป็นเงินสดไม่ได้)
th.amount: ทุน 50% จำนวน 2 ทุน (Bachelor of Business 1, Bachelor of IT 1); รองอันดับ 1 และ 2 สูงสุด 30%
th.eligibility: หนังสือเดินทางอินโดนีเซีย; เกรดเฉลี่ย SMA3 (หรือเทียบเท่า) อย่างน้อย 90%; ผ่านเกณฑ์วิชาการและภาษาอังกฤษของ KBS; มี Offer of Admission จาก KBS สำหรับปริญญาตรี Business หรือ IT ที่เริ่มเรียนปี 2027; ไม่มีผู้สนับสนุนทุน
th.notes: แข่งขัน: แบบฟอร์ม + วิดีโอสร้างสรรค์ต้นฉบับ 30 วินาที (ขั้นที่ 1) แล้วสัมภาษณ์วิชาการไม่เกิน 15 นาที (ขั้นที่ 2) ใช้ร่วมกับทุน ส่วนลด หรือโปรโมชันอื่นของ KBS ไม่ได้ เว้นแต่ KBS อนุมัติเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษร สมัครผ่านที่ปรึกษา Talented จำนวนจำกัด: ปิดรับสมัครก่อนกำหนดเมื่อได้รับใบสมัคร 80 ฉบับแรก แม้ยังไม่ถึง 31 มีนาคม 2027 - สมัครให้เร็วที่สุด
th.country: ออสเตรเลีย

vi.name: Học bổng KBS Excellence 2027 - Indonesia
vi.fields: Kinh doanh, Công nghệ thông tin
vi.coverage: Khấu trừ học phí (chỉ học phí, không quy đổi thành tiền mặt)
vi.amount: 2 suất 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); á quân 1 & 2 tối đa 30%
vi.eligibility: Hộ chiếu Indonesia; điểm trung bình SMA3 (hoặc tương đương) tối thiểu 90%; đáp ứng yêu cầu học thuật & tiếng Anh của KBS; có Offer of Admission của KBS cho chương trình cử nhân Business hoặc IT khai giảng năm 2027; không có nhà tài trợ.
vi.notes: Xét chọn cạnh tranh: đơn đăng ký + video sáng tạo gốc 30 giây (Vòng 1), sau đó phỏng vấn học thuật tối đa 15 phút (Vòng 2). Không kết hợp với học bổng, giảm giá hay khuyến mãi khác của KBS trừ khi KBS chấp thuận bằng văn bản. Đăng ký qua tư vấn viên Talented. Số lượng có hạn: ngừng nhận hồ sơ sớm khi đủ 80 hồ sơ đầu tiên, kể cả trước 31/03/2027 - hãy nộp sớm.

zh.name: KBS 卓越奖学金 2027 - 印度尼西亚
zh.fields: 商科、信息技术
zh.coverage: 抵扣学费（仅限学费，不可兑换现金）
zh.amount: 两个50%奖学金（商科学士1名、IT学士1名）；第一、第二亚军最高30%
zh.eligibility: 持印度尼西亚护照；SMA3（或同等学历）平均成绩至少90%；符合KBS学术及英语要求；持有2027年入学的KBS商科或IT学士录取通知书（Offer of Admission）；非受资助学生。
zh.notes: 竞争性评选：申请表 + 30秒原创创意视频（第一阶段），随后最长15分钟的学术面试（第二阶段）。除非KBS书面批准，不可与KBS其他奖学金、折扣或促销同时使用。请通过Talented顾问申请。 名额有限：收满前 80 份申请即提前截止（即使未到 2027 年 3 月 31 日），请尽早申请。

ja.name: KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - インドネシア
ja.fields: ビジネス、情報技術
ja.coverage: 授業料からの控除（授業料のみ、現金への交換不可）
ja.amount: 50%奨学金2件（Bachelor of Business 1件、Bachelor of IT 1件）；準優勝1位・2位は最大30%
ja.eligibility: インドネシアのパスポート；SMA3（または同等）の平均90%以上；KBSの学業・英語要件を満たす；2027年開始のBusinessまたはIT学士課程のKBS Offer of Admissionを保有；スポンサーなし。
ja.notes: 選考制：申請書＋30秒のオリジナル動画（第1段階）、その後最大15分の学術面接（第2段階）。KBSが書面で承認しない限り、KBSの他の奨学金・割引・プロモーションとの併用不可。Talentedのコンサルタント経由で申請。 定員あり：先着 80 件の応募に達した時点で、2027 年 3 月 31 日前でも締め切られます。早めに応募してください。

ko.name: KBS 엑설런스 장학금 2027 - 인도네시아
ko.fields: 비즈니스, 정보기술
ko.coverage: 등록금 공제 (등록금 한정, 현금 교환 불가)
ko.amount: 50% 장학금 2명 (Bachelor of Business 1명, Bachelor of IT 1명); 1·2위 차점자 최대 30%
ko.eligibility: 인도네시아 여권; SMA3(또는 동등) 평균 90% 이상; KBS 학업 및 영어 요건 충족; 2027년 시작 Business 또는 IT 학사과정 KBS Offer of Admission 보유; 후원 학생 아님.
ko.notes: 경쟁 선발: 신청서 + 30초 창작 영상(1단계), 이후 최대 15분 학업 인터뷰(2단계). KBS의 서면 승인 없이는 다른 KBS 장학금·할인·프로모션과 중복 불가. Talented 상담사를 통해 신청하세요. 인원 제한: 선착순 80건이 접수되면 2027년 3월 31일 이전이라도 조기 마감됩니다. 서둘러 지원하세요.

km.name: អាហារូបករណ៍ KBS Excellence 2027 - ឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី
km.fields: ពាណិជ្ជកម្ម, បច្ចេកវិទ្យាព័ត៌មាន
km.coverage: កាត់បន្ថយថ្លៃសិក្សា (តែថ្លៃសិក្សា មិនអាចប្តូរជាសាច់ប្រាក់)
km.amount: អាហារូបករណ៍ 50% ចំនួន 2 (Bachelor of Business 1, Bachelor of IT 1); ជ័យលាភីរង ទី1 និងទី2 រហូតដល់ 30%
km.eligibility: លិខិតឆ្លងដែនឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី; មធ្យមភាគ SMA3 (ឬស្មើ) យ៉ាងតិច 90%; បំពេញលក្ខខណ្ឌសិក្សា និងភាសាអង់គ្លេសរបស់ KBS; មាន Offer of Admission ពី KBS សម្រាប់បរិញ្ញាបត្រ Business ឬ IT ចាប់ផ្តើមឆ្នាំ 2027; មិនមែនជាសិស្សមានអ្នកឧបត្ថម្ភ។
km.notes: ការជ្រើសរើសប្រកួតប្រជែង៖ ពាក្យស្នើសុំ + វីដេអូច្នៃប្រឌិតដើម 30 វិនាទី (ដំណាក់កាលទី1) បន្ទាប់មកសម្ភាសន៍សិក្សារហូតដល់ 15 នាទី (ដំណាក់កាលទី2)។ មិនអាចប្រើរួមជាមួយអាហារូបករណ៍ ការបញ្ចុះតម្លៃ ឬប្រូម៉ូសិនផ្សេងរបស់ KBS លើកលែងតែ KBS យល់ព្រមជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរ។ ដាក់ពាក្យតាមរយៈទីប្រឹក្សា Talented។ ចំនួនមានកំណត់៖ បិទការដាក់ពាក្យមុនពេល នៅពេលទទួលបានពាក្យ 80 ដំបូង ទោះមិនទាន់ដល់ 31 មីនា 2027 ក៏ដោយ - សូមដាក់ពាក្យឱ្យបានឆាប់។
km.country: អូស្ត្រាលី

fr.name: Bourse KBS Excellence 2027 - Indonésie
fr.fields: Commerce, Technologies de l'information
fr.coverage: Crédit sur les frais de scolarité (frais de scolarité uniquement, non convertible en espèces)
fr.amount: Deux bourses de 50 % (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT) ; 1er et 2e finalistes jusqu'à 30 %
fr.eligibility: Passeport indonésien ; moyenne d'au moins 90 % en SMA3 (ou équivalent) ; conditions académiques et d'anglais de KBS remplies ; Offer of Admission de KBS pour un bachelor Business ou IT débutant en 2027 ; étudiant non parrainé.
fr.notes: Sélection compétitive : formulaire + vidéo créative originale de 30 secondes (étape 1), puis entretien académique de 15 minutes maximum (étape 2). Non cumulable avec une autre bourse, réduction ou promotion KBS sauf accord écrit de KBS. Candidature via un conseiller Talented. Places limitées : les candidatures ferment dès réception des 80 premiers dossiers, même avant le 31 mars 2027 - postulez tôt.

pt.name: Bolsa KBS Excellence 2027 - Indonésia
pt.fields: Negócios, Tecnologia da Informação
pt.coverage: Crédito na mensalidade (somente mensalidade, não conversível em dinheiro)
pt.amount: Duas bolsas de 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1º e 2º colocados seguintes até 30%
pt.eligibility: Passaporte indonésio; média mínima de 90% no SMA3 (ou equivalente); cumprir requisitos acadêmicos e de inglês da KBS; ter Offer of Admission da KBS para bacharelado em Business ou IT com início em 2027; não ser patrocinado.
pt.notes: Seleção competitiva: formulário + vídeo criativo original de 30 segundos (Etapa 1), depois entrevista acadêmica de até 15 minutos (Etapa 2). Não acumulável com outra bolsa, desconto ou promoção da KBS, salvo aprovação por escrito da KBS. Inscreva-se com um consultor Talented. Vagas limitadas: as inscrições encerram assim que as 80 primeiras forem recebidas, mesmo antes de 31 de março de 2027 - inscreva-se cedo.

es.name: Beca KBS Excellence 2027 - Indonesia
es.fields: Negocios, Tecnologías de la información
es.coverage: Crédito en la matrícula (solo matrícula, no canjeable por dinero)
es.amount: Dos becas del 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1.º y 2.º finalistas hasta 30%
es.eligibility: Pasaporte indonesio; promedio mínimo del 90% en SMA3 (o equivalente); cumplir los requisitos académicos y de inglés de KBS; tener Offer of Admission de KBS para un grado de Business o IT que comience en 2027; no estar patrocinado.
es.notes: Selección competitiva: formulario + vídeo creativo original de 30 segundos (Etapa 1) y entrevista académica de hasta 15 minutos (Etapa 2). No combinable con otra beca, descuento o promoción de KBS salvo aprobación escrita de KBS. Solicítala con un consultor de Talented. Plazas limitadas: la convocatoria cierra al recibir las primeras 80 solicitudes, incluso antes del 31 de marzo de 2027; postula pronto.

de.name: KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - Indonesien
de.fields: Wirtschaft, Informationstechnologie
de.coverage: Gutschrift auf die Studiengebühren (nur Studiengebühren, nicht in bar auszahlbar)
de.amount: Zwei 50-%-Stipendien (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1. und 2. Platzierte bis zu 30 %
de.eligibility: Indonesischer Reisepass; Durchschnitt von mindestens 90 % in SMA3 (oder gleichwertig); erfüllt die akademischen und Englisch-Anforderungen von KBS; KBS Offer of Admission für einen Business- oder IT-Bachelor mit Beginn 2027; nicht gesponsert.
de.notes: Wettbewerb: Antragsformular + originelles 30-Sekunden-Video (Stufe 1), danach akademisches Interview bis 15 Minuten (Stufe 2). Nicht kombinierbar mit anderen KBS-Stipendien, Rabatten oder Aktionen, außer mit schriftlicher Zustimmung von KBS. Bewerbung über eine Talented-Beratung. Begrenzte Plätze: Die Bewerbung schließt, sobald die ersten 80 Anträge eingegangen sind, auch vor dem 31. März 2027 - früh bewerben.

it.name: Borsa KBS Excellence 2027 - Indonesia
it.fields: Business, Tecnologia dell'informazione
it.coverage: Credito sulle tasse universitarie (solo tasse, non convertibile in denaro)
it.amount: Due borse del 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1° e 2° classificati successivi fino al 30%
it.eligibility: Passaporto indonesiano; media minima del 90% in SMA3 (o equivalente); requisiti accademici e di inglese KBS soddisfatti; Offer of Admission KBS per un bachelor in Business o IT con inizio nel 2027; non sponsorizzato.
it.notes: Selezione competitiva: modulo + video creativo originale di 30 secondi (Fase 1), poi colloquio accademico fino a 15 minuti (Fase 2). Non cumulabile con altre borse, sconti o promozioni KBS salvo approvazione scritta di KBS. Candidati tramite un consulente Talented. Posti limitati: le candidature chiudono al raggiungimento delle prime 80 domande, anche prima del 31 marzo 2027: candidati presto.

nl.name: KBS Excellence Scholarship 2027 - Indonesië
nl.fields: Bedrijfskunde, Informatietechnologie
nl.coverage: Korting op het collegegeld (alleen collegegeld, niet inwisselbaar voor geld)
nl.amount: Twee beurzen van 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1e en 2e runner-up tot 30%
nl.eligibility: Indonesisch paspoort; gemiddelde van minimaal 90% in SMA3 (of gelijkwaardig); voldoet aan de academische en Engelse eisen van KBS; heeft een KBS Offer of Admission voor een Business- of IT-bachelor die in 2027 start; niet gesponsord.
nl.notes: Competitieve selectie: aanvraagformulier + originele creatieve video van 30 seconden (fase 1), daarna een academisch interview van maximaal 15 minuten (fase 2). Niet te combineren met andere KBS-beurzen, kortingen of promoties tenzij KBS schriftelijk toestemming geeft. Aanvragen via een Talented-consultant. Beperkt aantal plaatsen: aanmelden sluit zodra de eerste 80 aanvragen binnen zijn, ook vóór 31 maart 2027 - meld je vroeg aan.

ru.name: Стипендия KBS Excellence 2027 - Индонезия
ru.fields: Бизнес, информационные технологии
ru.coverage: Зачёт в счёт оплаты обучения (только плата за обучение, не обменивается на деньги)
ru.amount: Две стипендии 50% (1 Bachelor of Business, 1 Bachelor of IT); 1-й и 2-й призёры до 30%
ru.eligibility: Паспорт Индонезии; средний балл SMA3 (или эквивалент) не ниже 90%; соответствие академическим и языковым требованиям KBS; Offer of Admission от KBS на бакалавриат Business или IT с началом в 2027 году; без спонсора.
ru.notes: Конкурсный отбор: анкета + оригинальное творческое видео 30 секунд (этап 1), затем академическое собеседование до 15 минут (этап 2). Не суммируется с другими стипендиями, скидками или акциями KBS без письменного согласия KBS. Подача через консультанта Talented. Количество мест ограничено: приём заявок закрывается досрочно после первых 80 заявок, даже до 31 марта 2027 г. — подавайте заранее.

items.name: Torrens University Motivational Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang (kecuali BMIHMS)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru berpaspor Afrika, Bhutan, Mauritius, Timur Tengah, Filipina, Asia Selatan, Asia Timur, dan Asia Tenggara (Indonesia tidak disebut eksplisit, termasuk wilayah Asia Tenggara); wajib beban studi penuh waktu.
items.notes: Isi International Student Scholarship Form. Halaman masih menyebut mulai studi 2026, belum ada keterangan intake 2027 - konfirmasi ke Torrens. Kuota terbatas; hanya untuk mata kuliah percobaan pertama.

en.name: Torrens University Motivational Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: New international students holding passports from Africa, Bhutan, Mauritius, the Middle East, the Philippines, South Asia, East Asia and Southeast Asia (Indonesia not named explicitly but is in Southeast Asia); full-time study load required.
en.notes: Complete the International Student Scholarship Form. The page still refers to starting study in 2026, with no information on the 2027 intake yet - confirm with Torrens. Limited places; first attempt of subjects only.

items.name: Three Pillars BMIHMS Hospitality Scholarship
items.provider: Torrens University Australia (Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School)
items.fields: Hospitality / Hotel Management
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru yang mendaftar di Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School (S1/S2); wajib beban studi penuh waktu 1 EFTSL per 12 bulan; berlaku untuk tuition mata kuliah percobaan pertama.
items.notes: Kuota terbatas, nilai 10%-50% tuition. Daftar dengan International Student Scholarship Form + dokumen pendukung. Halaman resmi saat ini masih menyebut pendaftaran untuk 2026; belum ada keterangan khusus intake 2027.

en.name: Three Pillars BMIHMS Hospitality Scholarship
en.provider: Torrens University Australia (Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study
en.eligibility: New international students enrolling at Blue Mountains International Hotel Management School (Bachelor's/Master's); full-time load of 1 EFTSL per 12 months required; applies to tuition for first-attempt subjects.
en.notes: Limited places, worth 10%-50% of tuition. Apply with the International Student Scholarship Form + supporting documents. The official page currently still refers to applications for 2026; no specific information on the 2027 intake yet.

items.name: Tasmanian International Scholarship (TIS)
items.fields: Semua bidang (kecuali mis. Bachelor of Medical Science & Doctor of Medicine, Dementia Care, kursus AMC Seafaring)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa studi (selama nilai memuaskan)
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S1/S2 coursework; dinilai dari IPK kumulatif kualifikasi tertinggi sebelumnya (min. 1 tahun).
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar; hasil tercantum di offer letter. Sebagian besar program tanpa tanggal tutup. Tidak dapat digabung dengan beasiswa tuition UTAS lain.

en.name: Tasmanian International Scholarship (TIS)
en.fields: All fields (except e.g. Bachelor of Medical Science & Doctor of Medicine, Dementia Care, AMC Seafaring courses)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the duration of study (while results are satisfactory)
en.eligibility: New international Bachelor's/coursework Master's students; assessed on the cumulative GPA of the highest previous qualification (min. 1 year).
en.notes: Assessed automatically when you apply; the result appears in your offer letter. Most programs have no closing date. Cannot be combined with other UTAS tuition scholarships.

items.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Undergraduate (2027)
items.fields: Semua bidang (tier tertinggi tidak untuk Kedokteran & Nursing)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition per tahun selama masa program
items.eligibility: Lulus SMA/setara, mendaftar S1 CRICOS dan memenuhi syarat akademik tier, mulai pertama kali 2027; tidak untuk kampus Sydney City.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi; otomatis dinilai. First-come-first-served sampai kuota habis; tidak bisa ditunda. Dokumen syarat & ketentuan yang ditautkan masih berjudul 2024-2026 - konfirmasi ketentuan 2027.

en.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Undergraduate (2027)
en.fields: All fields (top tier not for Medicine & Nursing)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction per year for the programme duration
en.eligibility: Completed high school or equivalent, applying for a CRICOS Bachelor's and meeting the tier's academic requirement, commencing for the first time in 2027; not for the Sydney City campus.
en.notes: No application; assessed automatically. First come, first served until places run out; cannot be deferred. The linked terms & conditions document is still titled 2024-2026 - confirm the 2027 terms.

items.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Postgraduate (2027)
items.fields: Semua bidang coursework (AUD 10.000 untuk Teaching, Social Work, Business Analytics, ICT, dll.)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition per tahun selama masa program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional baru S2 coursework (min. 1 tahun) yang memenuhi syarat akademik, mulai 2027; tidak untuk kampus Sydney City, HDR, atau Nursing pre-registration.
items.notes: Tanpa aplikasi; dibuka hingga kuota sesi terpenuhi.

en.name: Western Sydney International Scholarships - Postgraduate (2027)
en.fields: All coursework fields (AUD 10,000 for Teaching, Social Work, Business Analytics, ICT, etc.)
en.coverage: Tuition reduction per year for the programme duration
en.eligibility: New international coursework Master's students (min. 1 year) meeting academic requirements, starting in 2027; not for the Sydney City campus, HDR, or pre-registration Nursing.
en.notes: No application; open until each session's quota is filled.

items.name: UniSC Global Future Scholarship
items.fields: Semua bidang
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa program
items.eligibility: Pemegang paspor negara yang memenuhi syarat (Indonesia termasuk), mendaftar program S1/S2 coursework/pathway dan mulai kuliah di 2027.
items.notes: Otomatis tercantum di offer. Hanya dapat digabung dengan International Welcome Grant. Daftar negara dapat berubah - konfirmasi ke UniSC International.

en.name: UniSC Global Future Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the programme duration
en.eligibility: Passport holders of eligible countries (including Indonesia), applying for a Bachelor's/coursework Master's/pathway programme and starting in 2027.
en.notes: Included automatically in your offer. Can only be combined with the International Welcome Grant. The country list may change - confirm with UniSC International.

items.name: UniSC Bright Future Scholarship
items.fields: Nursing, Prosthetics & Orthotics, Engineering, Cyber Security, Social Work, Engineering Project Management
items.coverage: Potongan tuition selama masa program
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional pada program yang tercantum, mulai kuliah di 2027.
items.notes: Otomatis tercantum di offer; hanya bisa digabung dengan Welcome Grant.

en.name: UniSC Bright Future Scholarship
en.fields: Nursing, Prosthetics & Orthotics, Engineering, Cyber Security, Social Work, Engineering Project Management
en.coverage: Tuition reduction for the programme duration
en.eligibility: International students in the listed programmes, starting in 2027.
en.notes: Shown automatically in the offer; can only be combined with the Welcome Grant.

items.name: UniSC International Welcome Grant
items.fields: Semua bidang
items.coverage: Kredit ke tuition/biaya universitas senilai biaya visa pelajar (tidak termasuk OSHC)
items.eligibility: Pemohon utama visa pelajar baru dengan CoE UniSC, min. 48 unit di UniSC, mulai teaching period 2027.
items.notes: Dikreditkan setelah census date periode pertama; dapat digabung dengan beasiswa UniSC lain.

en.name: UniSC International Welcome Grant
en.coverage: Credit towards tuition/university fees equal to the student visa fee (OSHC not included)
en.eligibility: New primary student-visa applicants with a UniSC CoE, min. 48 units at UniSC, starting in a 2027 teaching period.
en.notes: Credited after the census date of the first period; can be combined with other UniSC scholarships.

items.name: International Excellence Scholarship 2027
items.fields: Semua bidang (program CRICOS; kecuali program berkuota)
items.coverage: Potongan tuition tahunan, diterapkan tiap term
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional full-fee yang mulai 2027 di program S1/S2 coursework CRICOS, latar akademik kuat, tinggal maks. 50 km dari kampus; bukan penerima Australia Awards/sponsor.
items.notes: Otomatis dinilai saat mendaftar; sekitar 500 penerima (indikatif). Tidak untuk program online/offshore, graduate certificate/diploma mandiri, atau penerima Australia Awards.

en.name: International Excellence Scholarship 2027
en.fields: All fields (CRICOS programmes; except quota programmes)
en.coverage: Annual tuition reduction, applied each term
en.eligibility: Full-fee international students starting in 2027 in a CRICOS Bachelor's/coursework Master's, strong academic background, living max. 50 km from campus; not Australia Awards/sponsored recipients.
en.notes: Assessed automatically when you apply; around 500 recipients (indicative). Not for online/offshore programs, standalone graduate certificates/diplomas, or Australia Awards recipients.

items.name: The Sir William Angliss International Merit Scholarships (VIC/NSW)
items.fields: Semua bidang (Hospitality, Kuliner, Pariwisata, Event)
items.coverage: Dana untuk pengembangan keterampilan, perjalanan, biaya hidup, dan perlengkapan studi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional aktif penuh waktu (VET/Higher Education) di Melbourne/Sydney yang telah menyelesaikan min. 1 semester dan berprestasi akademik.
items.notes: Untuk mahasiswa yang sudah kuliah di William Angliss (min. 1 semester penuh waktu). Halaman hanya menyebut 'relevant closing date' tanpa tanggal; hasil diumumkan dalam 10 minggu setelah tanggal tutup. Pantau halaman untuk ronde berikutnya.

en.name: The Sir William Angliss International Merit Scholarships (VIC/NSW)
en.coverage: Funds for skills development, travel, living costs and study equipment
en.eligibility: Current full-time international students (VET/Higher Education) in Melbourne/Sydney who have completed at least 1 semester with strong academic results.
en.notes: For students already studying at William Angliss (at least 1 full-time semester). The page only mentions a 'relevant closing date' with no date; results announced within 10 weeks of the closing date. Watch the page for the next round.

items.name: TAFE NSW 15% Higher Education Scholarship
items.fields: Program Higher Education TAFE NSW
items.coverage: Kredit tuition setiap semester (program tertentu: kredit AUD 1.000)
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional program Higher Education TAFE NSW; berbasis prestasi, dinilai panel beasiswa.
items.notes: Gunakan TAFE NSW International Scholarship Application Form; tutup pukul 17.00 AEST pada tanggal mulai kursus di offer letter.

en.name: TAFE NSW 15% Higher Education Scholarship
en.coverage: Tuition credit each semester (some programmes: AUD 1,000 credit)
en.eligibility: International students in TAFE NSW Higher Education programmes; merit-based, assessed by a scholarship panel.
en.notes: Use the TAFE NSW International Scholarship Application Form; closes 5 pm AEST on the course start date in the offer letter.

items.name: TAFE NSW $500 Vocational Course Scholarship
items.fields: Kursus vokasi tertentu
items.coverage: Kredit tuition vokasi
items.eligibility: Mahasiswa internasional pada kursus vokasi tertentu (daftar di PDF TAFE NSW); berbasis prestasi.
items.notes: Formulir sama dengan beasiswa 15%; tutup pada tanggal mulai kursus.

en.name: TAFE NSW $500 Vocational Course Scholarship
en.coverage: Vocational tuition credit
en.eligibility: International students in selected vocational courses (list in the TAFE NSW PDF); merit-based.
en.notes: Same form as the 15% scholarship; closes on the course start date.

items.name: AUD$5,000 WA Regional TAFE International Student Bursary

items.name: Beasiswa Pemerintah Jepang (MEXT/Monbukagakusho) - Research Student (rekomendasi Kedutaan)

items.fields: Semua bidang (harus linier dengan jurusan sebelumnya)
items.coverage: Tuition penuh (ujian, masuk, kuliah), tunjangan bulanan, tiket pesawat PP Indonesia-Jepang
items.eligibility: Lulusan D4/S1/S2, usia maks. 34 tahun per 1 April tahun keberangkatan, IPK disarankan min. 3,2, wajib sertifikat TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC (ETS) atau JLPT N2.
items.english_test: Siklus terakhir di halaman Kedubes: TOEFL iBT 72 / IELTS 5.5 / TOEIC L&R 785 atau JLPT N2 (sertifikat ETS/penyelenggara resmi; bisa berubah tiap tahun)
items.notes: Buku JASSO 2026-2027: rekrutmen jalur Kedubes dibuka sekitar April, tiba April/September/Oktober tahun berikutnya; ada juga jalur University Recommendation lewat universitas Jepang. Halaman Kedubes (dicek 24/11/2026) baru memuat siklus 2025 (registrasi 3-24 April 2024); putaran keberangkatan 2027 sudah tutup dan jadwal keberangkatan 2028 belum diumumkan. Tidak boleh mendaftar lebih dari satu program MEXT sekaligus.

en.name: Japanese Government (MEXT/Monbukagakusho) Scholarship - Research Student (Embassy recommendation)

en.coverage: Full tuition (exam, admission, tuition fees), monthly allowance, return airfare Indonesia-Japan
en.eligibility: D4/Bachelor's/Master's graduates, max. age 34 on 1 April of the departure year, recommended GPA min. 3.2, TOEFL/IELTS/TOEIC (ETS) certificate or JLPT N2 required.
en.english_test: Latest cycle on the Embassy page: TOEFL iBT 72 / IELTS 5.5 / TOEIC L&R 785 or JLPT N2 (official certificates; may change each year)
en.intake: April / September-October of the following year
en.notes: JASSO book 2026-2027: Embassy recruitment opens around April, arrival in April/September/October of the following year; there is also a University Recommendation route via Japanese universities. The Embassy page (checked 24/11/2026) still shows the 2025 cycle (registration 3-24 April 2024); the 2027 departure round is closed and the 2028 departure schedule is not yet announced. You may not apply to more than one MEXT programme at the same time.
