fr.fields: Programmes de Master et Postgraduate Diploma éligibles (hors Graduate Diploma)
fr.coverage: Réduction de NZD 10,000 sur les frais de scolarité de la 1re année (non renouvelable)
fr.eligibility: Nouveaux étudiants internationaux payant les frais internationaux complets, avec une Offer of Place ; exclut les boursiers gouvernementaux, transferts de crédits, échanges et citoyens/résidents australiens ou néo-zélandais
fr.english_test: Selon les conditions d’admission du programme VUW
fr.intake: Toutes les rentrées des programmes éligibles
fr.notes: Aucune candidature séparée : évaluation automatique lors de la candidature au programme, indiquée dans l’Offer of Place. Postulez via votre conseiller Talented.

pt.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
pt.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
pt.fields: Programas de Master e Postgraduate Diploma elegíveis (exceto Graduate Diploma)
pt.coverage: Desconto de NZD 10,000 na mensalidade do primeiro ano (não renovável)
pt.eligibility: Novos estudantes internacionais que pagam a taxa internacional integral, com Offer of Place; não vale para bolsistas do governo, transferência de créditos, intercâmbio ou cidadãos/residentes da Austrália/NZ
pt.english_test: Conforme os requisitos de admissão do programa da VUW
pt.intake: Todas as entradas dos programas elegíveis
pt.notes: Sem inscrição separada: avaliação automática ao se candidatar ao programa, informada na Offer of Place. Candidate-se pelo seu consultor Talented.

es.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
es.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
es.fields: Programas de Máster y Postgraduate Diploma elegibles (excepto Graduate Diploma)
es.coverage: Descuento de NZD 10,000 en la matrícula del primer año (no renovable)
es.eligibility: Nuevos estudiantes internacionales que pagan la tarifa internacional completa, con Offer of Place; no aplica a becados por el gobierno, transferencia de créditos, intercambio ni ciudadanos/residentes de Australia/NZ
es.english_test: Según los requisitos de admisión del programa de VUW
es.intake: Todos los ingresos de los programas elegibles
es.notes: Sin solicitud aparte: se evalúa automáticamente al postular al programa y se indica en la Offer of Place. Postula a través de tu asesor Talented.

de.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
de.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
de.fields: Berechtigte Master- und Postgraduate-Diploma-Programme (keine Graduate Diplomas)
de.coverage: NZD 10,000 Nachlass auf die Studiengebühren im ersten Jahr (nicht verlängerbar)
de.eligibility: Neue internationale Studierende mit vollen internationalen Gebühren und Offer of Place; nicht für staatlich geförderte Studierende, Anrechnung von Leistungen, Austauschstudierende oder Bürger/Einwohner Australiens/Neuseelands
de.notes: Keine separate Bewerbung: automatische Prüfung bei der Programmbewerbung, Mitteilung im Offer of Place. Bewerbung über Ihren Talented-Berater.

it.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
it.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
it.fields: Programmi di Master e Postgraduate Diploma idonei (esclusi i Graduate Diploma)
it.coverage: Riduzione di NZD 10,000 sulle tasse del primo anno (non rinnovabile)
it.eligibility: Nuovi studenti internazionali che pagano la tariffa internazionale piena, con Offer of Place; esclusi borsisti governativi, riconoscimento crediti, scambi e cittadini/residenti australiani o neozelandesi
it.english_test: Secondo i requisiti di ammissione del programma VUW
it.intake: Tutti gli ingressi dei programmi idonei
it.notes: Nessuna domanda separata: valutazione automatica alla candidatura al programma, comunicata nell’Offer of Place. Candidati tramite il tuo consulente Talented.

nl.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
nl.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
nl.fields: In aanmerking komende master- en Postgraduate Diploma-opleidingen (geen Graduate Diploma)
nl.coverage: NZD 10,000 korting op het collegegeld van het eerste jaar (niet verlengbaar)
nl.eligibility: Nieuwe internationale studenten die het volledige internationale tarief betalen, met een Offer of Place; niet voor overheidsbeursstudenten, studiepuntoverdracht, uitwisseling of Australische/NZ-burgers en -ingezetenen
nl.english_test: Volgens de toelatingseisen van de VUW-opleiding
nl.intake: Alle instroommomenten van in aanmerking komende opleidingen
nl.notes: Geen aparte aanvraag: automatisch beoordeeld bij je aanmelding voor de opleiding en vermeld in je Offer of Place. Meld je aan via je Talented-consulent.

ru.name: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
ru.provider: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
ru.fields: Подходящие программы магистратуры и Postgraduate Diploma (кроме Graduate Diploma)
ru.coverage: Скидка NZD 10,000 на обучение в первый год (не продлевается)
ru.eligibility: Новые иностранные студенты, оплачивающие полный международный тариф, с Offer of Place; не для получателей государственных стипендий, перезачёта кредитов, обмена и граждан/резидентов Австралии и Новой Зеландии
ru.notes: Отдельная заявка не нужна: оценивается автоматически при подаче на программу и указывается в Offer of Place. Подавайте через консультанта Talented.

items.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
items.fields: Program Bachelor CRICOS (kecuali Honours 1 tahun, semua program WAAPA & daftar pengecualian) dan Master by Coursework tertentu (Arts & Humanities, Business & Law, Education, Engineering, Science, Medical & Health Sciences, Nursing & Midwifery)
items.coverage: Potongan 20% tuition selama durasi standar program (hanya tuition)
items.eligibility: Warga negara ASEAN yang memenuhi syarat (Indonesia termasuk); mulai S1/S2 coursework ECU tahun 2027 di kampus Joondalup, City atau South West; full-fee, bukan penerima beasiswa pemerintah/sponsor industri; memenuhi syarat masuk ECU. Halaman resmi juga mencantumkan syarat terdaftar di paket pathway dengan mitra pathway resmi ECU.
items.notes: Tidak perlu daftar terpisah: dinilai otomatis saat apply program ECU, tercantum di Letter of Offer. Wajib full-time & nilai baik agar tetap berlaku. Syarat paket pathway di halaman resmi perlu dikonfirmasi ke ECU untuk siswa direct entry. Tidak bisa digabung beasiswa ECU lain kecuali disetujui ECU. Daftar lewat konsultan Talented.

en.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
en.fields: CRICOS Bachelor courses (excl. 1-year Honours, all WAAPA courses & listed exclusions) and selected Master by Coursework courses (Arts & Humanities, Business & Law, Education, Engineering, Science, Medical & Health Sciences, Nursing & Midwifery)
en.coverage: 20% tuition fee reduction for the standard course duration (tuition only)
en.eligibility: Citizens of eligible ASEAN countries (incl. Indonesia) starting an ECU undergraduate or Master by Coursework course in 2027 at Joondalup, City or South West campus; full-fee, not government- or industry-sponsored; meet ECU entry requirements. The official page also lists enrolment in a packaged pathway course with an ECU registered pathway partner.
en.english_test: As per ECU course entry requirements
en.notes: No separate application: assessed automatically when you apply and shown in the Letter of Offer. Must stay full-time in good standing. Confirm the pathway-package requirement with ECU for direct-entry students. Not combinable with other ECU scholarships unless ECU approves. Apply through your Talented consultant.

th.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
th.country: ออสเตรเลีย
th.fields: หลักสูตรปริญญาตรีที่จดทะเบียน CRICOS (ยกเว้น Honours 1 ปี หลักสูตร WAAPA และรายการยกเว้น) และหลักสูตรปริญญาโทแบบ coursework ที่กำหนด
th.coverage: ลดค่าเล่าเรียน 20% ตลอดระยะเวลามาตรฐานของหลักสูตร (เฉพาะค่าเล่าเรียน)
th.amount: ลดค่าเล่าเรียน 20%
th.eligibility: พลเมืองประเทศอาเซียนที่มีสิทธิ์ (รวมอินโดนีเซีย) ที่เริ่มเรียนปริญญาตรีหรือโทแบบ coursework ที่ ECU ในปี 2027 ณ วิทยาเขต Joondalup, City หรือ South West; จ่ายค่าเรียนเต็ม ไม่ได้รับทุนรัฐบาล/สปอนเซอร์; หน้าเว็บทางการระบุเงื่อนไขการลงทะเบียนในแพ็กเกจ pathway กับพันธมิตร ECU ด้วย
th.english_test: ตามเกณฑ์รับเข้าหลักสูตรของ ECU
th.intake: ทุกรอบปี 2027 (เลื่อนไม่ได้)
th.notes: ไม่ต้องสมัครแยก พิจารณาอัตโนมัติและแจ้งใน Letter of Offer ควรยืนยันเงื่อนไข pathway กับ ECU สำหรับผู้สมัครตรง สมัครผ่านที่ปรึกษา Talented

vi.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
vi.fields: Các chương trình Cử nhân CRICOS (trừ Honours 1 năm, các khóa WAAPA và danh sách loại trừ) và một số chương trình Thạc sĩ theo học phần
vi.coverage: Giảm 20% học phí trong thời gian chuẩn của khóa học (chỉ học phí)
vi.eligibility: Công dân các nước ASEAN đủ điều kiện (gồm Indonesia) bắt đầu chương trình đại học hoặc Thạc sĩ học phần tại ECU năm 2027 ở cơ sở Joondalup, City hoặc South West; tự túc toàn phần, không nhận học bổng chính phủ/tài trợ; trang chính thức cũng nêu điều kiện học gói pathway với đối tác pathway của ECU
vi.english_test: Theo yêu cầu đầu vào của ECU
vi.intake: Tất cả kỳ nhập học 2027 (không bảo lưu)
vi.notes: Không cần nộp đơn riêng: tự động xét khi nộp hồ sơ và ghi trong Letter of Offer. Nên xác nhận điều kiện pathway với ECU nếu nhập học trực tiếp. Nộp hồ sơ qua tư vấn viên Talented.

zh.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
zh.fields: CRICOS 注册学士课程（不含一年制荣誉学士、WAAPA 课程及排除清单）及指定授课型硕士课程
zh.coverage: 课程标准学制内学费减免 20%（仅限学费）
zh.eligibility: 符合条件的东盟国家公民（含印尼），2027 年在 ECU Joondalup、City 或 South West 校区开始学士或授课型硕士课程；全额自费，非政府/企业资助；官方页面还列明须就读 ECU 注册衔接合作方的打包衔接课程
zh.english_test: 按 ECU 课程入学要求
zh.intake: 2027 年所有入学批次（不可延期）
zh.notes: 无需单独申请：申请课程时自动评估，并在 Letter of Offer 中注明。直录学生请向 ECU 确认衔接课程要求。请通过 Talented 顾问申请。

ja.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
ja.fields: CRICOS 登録の学士課程（1年制 Honours、WAAPA 全課程、除外リストを除く）および指定のコースワーク修士課程
ja.coverage: 標準修業期間中の授業料 20% 減額（授業料のみ）
ja.eligibility: 対象 ASEAN 諸国の国民（インドネシア含む）で、2027年に ECU の Joondalup・City・South West キャンパスで学士またはコースワーク修士を開始する者。全額自費で政府・企業の奨学金受給者でないこと。公式ページには ECU 登録パスウェイ提携校のパッケージ課程在籍の条件も記載
ja.english_test: ECU の入学要件に準ずる
ja.notes: 別途申請不要：出願時に自動審査され Letter of Offer に記載。直接入学の場合はパスウェイ条件を ECU に確認。Talented のコンサルタント経由で出願。

ko.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
ko.fields: CRICOS 등록 학사 과정(1년제 Honours, WAAPA 전 과정 및 제외 목록 제외)과 지정 코스워크 석사 과정
ko.coverage: 표준 수업 기간 동안 등록금 20% 감면(등록금만)
ko.eligibility: 자격 있는 아세안 국가 시민(인도네시아 포함)으로 2027년 ECU Joondalup·City·South West 캠퍼스에서 학사 또는 코스워크 석사를 시작하는 학생; 전액 자비, 정부/기업 후원 없음; 공식 페이지에는 ECU 등록 패스웨이 파트너의 패키지 과정 등록 조건도 명시
ko.notes: 별도 신청 불필요: 지원 시 자동 심사되며 Letter of Offer에 명시. 직접 입학생은 패스웨이 조건을 ECU에 확인. Talented 컨설턴트를 통해 지원.

km.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
km.country: អូស្ត្រាលី
km.fields: កម្មវិធីបរិញ្ញាបត្រ CRICOS (លើកលែង Honours ១ឆ្នាំ វគ្គ WAAPA និងបញ្ជីលើកលែង) និងកម្មវិធីអនុបណ្ឌិតតាមមុខវិជ្ជាដែលបានកំណត់
km.coverage: បញ្ចុះថ្លៃសិក្សា ២០% ក្នុងរយៈពេលស្តង់ដារនៃវគ្គសិក្សា (តែថ្លៃសិក្សា)
km.amount: បញ្ចុះថ្លៃសិក្សា ២០%
km.eligibility: ពលរដ្ឋប្រទេសអាស៊ាន (រួមទាំងឥណ្ឌូនេស៊ី) ដែលចាប់ផ្តើមបរិញ្ញាបត្រ ឬអនុបណ្ឌិតនៅ ECU ឆ្នាំ 2027 នៅបរិវេណ Joondalup, City ឬ South West; បង់ថ្លៃពេញ មិនទទួលអាហារូបករណ៍រដ្ឋាភិបាល; ទំព័រផ្លូវការក៏ចែងលក្ខខណ្ឌចុះឈ្មោះក្នុងកញ្ចប់ pathway ជាមួយដៃគូ ECU ផងដែរ
km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌចូលរៀនរបស់ ECU
km.intake: គ្រប់វគ្គចូលរៀនឆ្នាំ 2027 (មិនអាចពន្យារ)
km.notes: មិនចាំបាច់ដាក់ពាក្យដាច់ដោយឡែក៖ វាយតម្លៃដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ និងបង្ហាញក្នុង Letter of Offer។ សូមបញ្ជាក់លក្ខខណ្ឌ pathway ជាមួយ ECU។ ដាក់ពាក្យតាមអ្នកប្រឹក្សា Talented។

fr.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
fr.fields: Licences (Bachelor) enregistrées CRICOS (sauf Honours d'un an, cursus WAAPA et exclusions) et certains Masters by Coursework
fr.coverage: Réduction de 20 % des frais de scolarité pendant la durée normale du cursus (scolarité uniquement)
fr.amount: Réduction de 20 % des frais de scolarité
fr.eligibility: Citoyens des pays de l'ASEAN éligibles (dont l'Indonésie) commençant une licence ou un Master by Coursework à ECU en 2027 sur les campus Joondalup, City ou South West ; frais pleins, sans bourse gouvernementale ni parrainage ; la page officielle mentionne aussi l'inscription dans un parcours pathway avec un partenaire agréé ECU
fr.english_test: Selon les conditions d'admission d'ECU
fr.notes: Pas de candidature séparée : évaluation automatique, indiquée dans la Letter of Offer. Confirmer auprès d'ECU la condition de pathway pour une admission directe. Candidature via votre conseiller Talented.

pt.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
pt.fields: Bacharelados registrados no CRICOS (exceto Honours de 1 ano, cursos WAAPA e exclusões listadas) e Mestrados por Coursework selecionados
pt.coverage: Redução de 20% da anuidade durante a duração padrão do curso (somente anuidade)
pt.eligibility: Cidadãos de países da ASEAN elegíveis (incluindo Indonésia) que iniciem bacharelado ou Mestrado por Coursework na ECU em 2027 nos campi Joondalup, City ou South West; pagantes integrais, sem bolsa governamental ou patrocínio; a página oficial também exige matrícula em pacote pathway com parceiro registrado da ECU
pt.english_test: Conforme requisitos de admissão da ECU
pt.intake: Todas as entradas de 2027 (não pode ser adiada)
pt.notes: Sem inscrição separada: avaliação automática, informada na Letter of Offer. Confirme com a ECU o requisito de pathway para entrada direta. Inscreva-se pelo consultor Talented.

es.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
es.fields: Grados (Bachelor) registrados en CRICOS (excepto Honours de 1 año, cursos WAAPA y exclusiones) y ciertos Másteres por Coursework
es.coverage: Reducción del 20% de la matrícula durante la duración estándar del programa (solo matrícula)
es.eligibility: Ciudadanos de países ASEAN elegibles (incluida Indonesia) que comiencen un grado o Máster por Coursework en ECU en 2027 en los campus Joondalup, City o South West; pago completo, sin beca gubernamental ni patrocinio; la página oficial también exige matrícula en un paquete pathway con un socio registrado de ECU
es.english_test: Según requisitos de admisión de ECU
es.notes: Sin solicitud aparte: evaluación automática, indicada en la Letter of Offer. Confirme con ECU el requisito de pathway para ingreso directo. Solicite a través de su asesor Talented.

de.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
de.fields: CRICOS-registrierte Bachelor-Studiengänge (außer 1-jähriges Honours, WAAPA-Kurse und Ausschlüsse) und ausgewählte Master by Coursework
de.coverage: 20 % Studiengebührenermäßigung für die Regelstudienzeit (nur Studiengebühren)
de.eligibility: Staatsangehörige berechtigter ASEAN-Länder (inkl. Indonesien), die 2027 einen Bachelor oder Master by Coursework an der ECU (Campus Joondalup, City oder South West) beginnen; Vollzahler, ohne Regierungsstipendium oder Sponsoring; die offizielle Seite nennt zudem die Einschreibung in ein Pathway-Paket mit einem registrierten ECU-Partner
de.notes: Keine separate Bewerbung: automatische Prüfung, Angabe im Letter of Offer. Pathway-Bedingung bei Direkteinstieg mit ECU klären. Bewerbung über Ihren Talented-Berater.

it.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
it.fields: Corsi di Bachelor registrati CRICOS (esclusi Honours di 1 anno, corsi WAAPA ed esclusioni) e alcuni Master by Coursework
it.coverage: Riduzione del 20% delle tasse per la durata standard del corso (solo tasse)
it.eligibility: Cittadini dei paesi ASEAN idonei (inclusa l'Indonesia) che iniziano un Bachelor o Master by Coursework a ECU nel 2027 nei campus Joondalup, City o South West; a pagamento pieno, senza borse governative o sponsor; la pagina ufficiale richiede anche l'iscrizione a un pacchetto pathway con un partner registrato ECU
it.english_test: Secondo i requisiti di ammissione ECU
it.notes: Nessuna domanda separata: valutazione automatica, indicata nella Letter of Offer. Verificare con ECU il requisito pathway per l'ingresso diretto. Candidati tramite il consulente Talented.

nl.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
nl.fields: CRICOS-geregistreerde bacheloropleidingen (excl. 1-jarige Honours, WAAPA-opleidingen en uitzonderingen) en geselecteerde Master by Coursework
nl.coverage: 20% korting op collegegeld voor de standaardduur van de opleiding (alleen collegegeld)
nl.eligibility: Burgers van in aanmerking komende ASEAN-landen (incl. Indonesië) die in 2027 een bachelor of Master by Coursework aan ECU starten op campus Joondalup, City of South West; volledig betalend, geen overheidsbeurs of sponsoring; de officiële pagina noemt ook inschrijving in een pathway-pakket met een geregistreerde ECU-partner
nl.english_test: Volgens toelatingseisen van ECU
nl.notes: Geen aparte aanvraag: automatisch beoordeeld, vermeld in de Letter of Offer. Bevestig de pathway-eis bij ECU voor directe toelating. Aanmelden via je Talented-consulent.

ru.name: 2027 ECU ASEAN International Scholarship
ru.fields: Программы бакалавриата CRICOS (кроме 1-летнего Honours, курсов WAAPA и исключений) и отдельные магистратуры по курсовой программе
ru.coverage: Скидка 20% на обучение на стандартный срок программы (только плата за обучение)
ru.eligibility: Граждане стран АСЕАН (включая Индонезию), начинающие бакалавриат или магистратуру в ECU в 2027 году в кампусах Joondalup, City или South West; полная оплата, без государственных стипендий и спонсорства; на официальной странице также указано обучение в пакетной pathway-программе с партнёром ECU

en.name: UTS Southeast Asia International Scholarship

Selection on academic merit.

th.name: UTS Southeast Asia International Scholarship

km.english_test: តាមលក្ខខណ្ឌចូលរៀនរបស់ UTS
